thread.title: BMO Capital Maintains a Hold Rating on Apple (AAPL)

author: Ryan Adist
title: BMO Capital Maintains a Hold Rating on Apple (AAPL)
text:
By Ryan Adsit
In a report released today, Tim Long from BMO Capital maintained a Hold rating on Apple ( AAPL – Research Report ), with a price target of $153 . closed yesterday at $154.68, close to its 52-week low of $142.
 Long is a 5-star analyst with 18.0% and a 62.8% success rate. Long covers the Consumer Goods sector, focusing on stocks such as Dell Technologies Inc, Motorola Solutions, and BlackBerry Limited.
Apple has an analyst consensus of Moderate Buy, with a price target consensus of $181.26, a 17.2% upside from current levels. In a report issued on January 18, Longbow Research also maintained a Hold rating on the stock.
See today’s analyst top recommended stocks >>
Apple’s market cap is currently $735.5B and has a P/E ratio of 13.03. The company has a Price to Book ratio of 6.86.
Based on the recent corporate insider activity of 58 insiders, corporate insider sentiment is positive on the stock. This means that over the past quarter there has been an increase of insiders buying their shares of AAPL in relation to earlier this year. Earlier this month, Albert Gore, a Director at AAPL bought 35,000 shares for a total of $507,850.
